payload.text: **NEVER SHARE A CARGO TARGET DIR BETWEEN WORKTREES, NOT EVEN ONE AFTER ANOTHER** (2026-09-17). Cargo hashes a path dependency relative to the workspace root, so two worktrees write the SAME artifact names, and a crate whose sources did not change reads fresh and keeps the other worktree's compile-time `env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")`. My red run in wt-red rebuilt testkit into wt-wp04's target; I removed wt-red; the next suite in wt-wp04 went 88 and 266 arms red on testkit's root search. The judging run before it was sound only because it came first. The reverse is worse: a copied target keeps the source worktree's paths, which still exist, so the arms read the WRONG tree and pass. Give every worktree its own target; to keep warm dependencies, copy the target and `cargo clean -p` every workspace member before the first build.
